## 1. Verdict
144 bytes, exactly one byte differs from out2.srt: offset 40 `0x72` ('r' in "Hello world") → `0xf2` — a genuine single-bit flip (MSB set), python-verified (`diff offsets: [40] orig/flip: [('0x72','0xf2')]`). The result is an invalid UTF-8 lead byte inside cue text, forcing the parser down its encoding-fallback / lossy path mid-document while cues 2–3 must still survive. Offset 40 = 8+16×2, matching the documented "bit flips at 8/24-byte strides" scheme (the flip2 family steps at 8-byte strides). Survival invariants (damage cap, interval validity, no panic) run over it and pass. No defects.
